name: cloudflare-feed-reader
description: A private RSS/Atom/JSON feed reader for Cloudflare Pages Functions and D1, with a companion cron Worker.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && node scripts/verify/verify-feed.mjs "$PWD" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" && node scripts/verify/verify-scrape.mjs "$PWD" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" && node scripts/verify/verify-poller.mjs "$PWD" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" && node scripts/verify/verify-page.mjs "$PWD" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" && node scripts/verify/verify-action.mjs "$PWD" "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}"
